column1: # Path glob -> work package (BUILD-PLAN §2). Read by tools/owners-check.
# First matching row wins, so specific rows sit above broader ones.
# Globs: * = any characters except /, ** = any characters, {a,b} = either.
# GEN paths (written only by tools/build, tools/assemble, tools/fixtures-gen,
# tools/canary-baseline, tools/helper-replies-gen) belong to build: the
# integrator commits them on main, never a WP branch.
# The launcher leaves plugin/bin/ in the launcher move (BLD-01, PKG-RUNTIME Q-R1); this row stays
# until that move has removed the old folder, so the removal itself is owned.
# Design-pass rulings of 2026-10-21 (REVIEW (D) step 1). The lib and case rows below restate
# the broader rows on purpose, so each note's new path shows its owner: Dev-7 wait, Dev-1
# jobs, D-12 export/project/repomode, D-18 handoff-turn/handoff-state (one core lib the
# skills call, DP-6 / B-18), D-10 queue-add.
